# OpenSRM Service Reliability Manifest
# Migrated from legacy NthLayer format
# Original file: api-minimal.yaml
#
# For more information, see:
# https://github.com/rsionnach/opensrm
#

apiVersion: srm/v1
kind: ServiceReliabilityManifest
metadata:
  name: api-minimal
  team: platform
  tier: critical
spec:
  type: api
  slos:
    availability:
      type: availability
      target: 99.9
      window: 30d
    latency-p95:
      type: latency
      target: 99.0
      window: 30d
  ownership:
    team: platform
